prose:
Simon Willison collects Scott Aaronson's comparison of recent AI-assisted complexity results to a new observational instrument opening a larger mathematical landscape. The item is a selected quotation emphasizing Aaronson's enthusiasm rather than a separate technical analysis.

The fuller [Aaronson post](../summaries/9812986779ff.md) retains his personal judgments, predictions and uncertainty about specific cryptographic rumors. Reprinting the metaphor adds no independent proof verification or additional theorem. It should not be used to claim that every newly circulated manuscript has been checked or that Boolean P versus NP is resolved.
highlights: Item is a quotation rather than a new investigation
No independent proof review is supplied
No cryptographic break or Boolean separation is established
